D1INTRO1 = "THE STORY SO FAR:\n"

column3: "You're a marine, one of Earth's toughest,\n"
"hardened in combat and trained for action.\n"
"You have been transferred to Mars, home of\n"
"the Union Aerospace Corporation (U.A.C).\n"
"For the last four years the military, its biggest\n"
"provider, has used the remote facilities on Phobos\n"
"and Deimos to conduct research on inter-dimensional\n"
"space travel.";

column1: D1INTRO2 = "THE INCITING INCIDENT:\n"

column3: "A few hours ago, Mars received a\n"
"garbled message from Phobos. 'We require\n"
"immediate military support. Something fraggin'\n"
"evil is coming out of the Gateways! Computer\n"
"systems have gone berserk!' The rest was\n"
"incoherent. Soon afterwards, Deimos simply\n"
"vanished from the sky.\n"
"Since then, attempts to establish contact with\n"
"either moon base have been unsuccessful.";

column1: D1INTRO3 = "TRUE HORRORS AWAIT:\n"

column3: "You and your buddies were sent\n"
"to Phobos. You were ordered to\n"
"secure the perimeter while the rest\n"
"went inside.\n"
"For several hours, your radio picked up\n"
"the sounds of combat: guns firing, screams,\n"
"then finally, silence. Seems your buddies\n"
"are dead.";

column1: D1INTRO4 = "IT'S UP TO YOU:\n"

column3: "Things aren't looking too good.\n"
"All the heavy weapons were taken\n"
"by the assault team leaving you with\n"
"only a pistol. Securing your helmet,\n"
"you exit the landing pod.\n"
"As you walk through the main entrance,\n"
"you hear animal-like growls echoing throughout\n"
"the distant corridors. They know you're here.\n"
"There's no turning back now.";

column1: E1TEXT = "Once you beat the big badasses and\n"

column3: clean out the moon base you're supposed\n
to win, aren't you? Aren't you? Where's\n
your fat reward and ticket home? What\n
the hell is this? It's not supposed to\n
end this way!\n\n
It stinks like rotten meat, but looks\n
like the lost Deimos base.  Looks like\n
you're stuck on the shores of hell.\n
The only way out is through.;

column1: //Edited to remove the advertisement for episode 2 and 3. Makes it more cohesive that way.
E2INTRO1 = "After you cleaned up most of the Phobos base\n"

column3: "and triumphed over the Bruiser Brothers at the anomaly,\n"
"you hoped to catch a ride back home,\n"
"take a well deserved rest with your pet rabbit\n"
"by your side.";

column1: E2INTRO2 = "Instead, what you find in front of you is a bizarre\n"

column3: "altar that irradiates some kind of unknown wicked energy.\n"
"You approach with extreme caution but before you\n"
"know it, you get sucked right in. The evil spirits'\n"
"screeching pierces your mind as you feel your body\n"
"being torn inside out. You black out.";

column1: E2INTRO3 = "You awake from the nightmare, alive yet stripped down\n"

column3: "with only your handgun once again.\n"
"Upon furher assassment, you realize that you're at the lost\n"
"Deimos base which disappeared hours ago.\n"
"Now reeking of rotten corpses and contaminated blood.\n"
"Whoever they are, They'll pay for what they did\n"
"to your buddies.";

column1: //Original text by me, Manardo. revisions by owlet VII. Basically a more detailed version of the ending text.
E2TEXT = "You've done it! The hideous cyber-\n"

column3: "demon lord that ruled the lost Deimos\n"
"moon base has been slain and you\n"
"are triumphant! But ... where are\n"
"you? You clamber to the edge of the\n"
"moon and look down to see the awful\n"
"truth.\n\n"
"Deimos floats above Hell itself!\n"
"You've never heard of anyone escaping\n"
"from Hell, but you'll make the bastards\n"
"sorry they ever heard of you! Quickly,\n"
"you rappel down to the surface of Hell.";

column1: //Same reason as episode 1.
E3INTRO1 = "With the lord cyberdemon that overlooked the lost\n"

column3: "Deimos base, turned viscous human torcher grounds,\n"
"been reduced to nothing but a pair of bloody metal hooves,\n"
"you gloat to yourself with nothing but a savage\n"
"grin on your face. Your buddies have seemingly\n"
"been avenged.";

column1: E3INTRO2 = "However, this feeling of victory soon goes hollow.\n"

column3: "You felt the beast wasn't acting on it's own accord.\n"
"Suddenly, you felt an evil presence like none before\n"
"lurking around in the outskirts. Perhaps this greater evil was\n"
"the one puppetering that abomination. You leave the tower and\n"
"persue it to the very edge of deimos to find the horrible truth.\n"
"That the base now floats above the depths of hell itself!";

column1: E3INTRO3 = "Staring down at it only makes you angrier, while you never\n"

column3: "heard anyone escape from hell before, you'll be sure that the\n"
"bastards regret ever crossing you! After securing an empty pod,\n"
"you quickly rappel down to the burning inferno below,\n"
"crashing landing the pod in the process.\n"
"Armmed with nothing but your lucky pistol and a taste of\n"
"vengence, you take your first step into hell...";

column1: //Another original text by me. Like what I did perviously, it's the episode 2 text with more detail.

column3: "spidermastermind and it's army had brought to\n"
"the moon bases, a hidden doorway opens nearby.\n"
"It appears that hell has finally let up, as\n"

column1: E4INTRO2 = "As you take off your helmet to take a breath\n"

column3: "of fresh air in god knows how long, you sense a\n"
"faint smokey scent coming from somewhere distant.\n"
"To your Horror, the source is a nearby city in flames.\n"
"Surrouding the catastrophe are familiar structers\n"

column1: E4INTRO3 = "Worst of all, near the outskirts of the city\n"

column3: "sits the head of your pet rabbit, Daisy,\n"
"Mounted on a pike in a form mochery by the invaders.\n"
"At that moment you curse under your breath\n"
"Those bastards, They'll pay for that!\n"
"Full of anger, you blindly make haste to a nearby\n"

column3: "its legions of hellspawn before your\n"

"and brought forth eternal damnation and\n"

"besides, someone was gonna pay for what\n"

"but now, you see spread before you more\n"

"next stop, hell on earth!";

column1: E5INTRO1 =
THE STORY SO FAR:\n\n
Having killed the spider mastermind and most\n
of the initial horde that stood guard of the\n
final teleporter on earth, your next stop is\n
the Central U.A.C Star port—where what's left\n
of civilization remains.\n;
E5INTRO2 =
NEXT STOP, HELL ON EARTH:\n\n
You must save mankind from the remining demons\n
that are causing unimaginable carnage in our cities.\n
With big guns in hand,you make haste for the teleporter.\n;
E5INTRO3 =
A GREAT EVIL INTERFERES:\n\n
Unbeknownst to you, an all powerful demon, known\n
as the Baphomet, glitched the final teleporter\n
with his hidden sigil. Its eldritch power drags\n
you to a darker part of hell that's nothing like\n
where you've been before\n;
E5INTRO4 =
ADMIST BLOOD RED DARKNESS:\n\n
Now with nothing but a hardy shotgun and your own\n
guts, you must fight through this stygian pocket of\n
evil, confront any grand harbingers of Satan, and\n
then return to earth to become its savior.\n
\n
Rip & Tear!; //Bleh.
//Taken from the existing story text with some details altered to match cannon better
//Ex: episode 4 being set on earth and not in hell or a weird inbetween pocket dimention.
E6INTRO1 =
Baphomet's plan to drag you back to hell only\n
ended with him realizing why he failed in the\n
first place.\n
\n
Just like before, you've got done mopping up\n
the place with your arsenal and are ready to go\n
down into the wormhole and become the savior of earth.;
E6INTRO2 =
but once again you fall for another cunning trap,\n
set this time by none other then satan himself.\n
\n
His evil cackle echos as you are pulled into\n
an even more grotesque and vile dimension then what\n
you've had been through thus far; filled with hell's\n
most relentless killing machines.;
E6INTRO3 =
Doesn't matter how far they drag you though, time\n
and time again they have underestimated your sheer\n
power.\n
\n
time to show satan your metal!;
D2INTRO1 =
The Story Continues...\n
\n
Back at last. After so many weeks\n
of hard fighting, you've returned home\n
Damn! The city ahead is on fire. Packs\n
of refugees are fleeing the flaming\n
metropolis. Hell, not again!;
D2INTRO2 =
You can feel it. It's all starting\n
again, just like in space. First, people\n
are taken over, turned into cannibal\n
Things. Then the real horror starts, the\n
deformed monstrosities from Outside. But\n
now it's on Earth!;
D2INTRO3 =
Unfortunately, Earth's only ground\n
spaceport has just been taken over by\n
the demons. They've instituted a sort of\n
force field -- a flame barrier -- over\n
the port; no ships can land or take off.\n
You gotta go back into action. If you\n
win, you might be able to turn off the\n
barrier, so that the ships can leave.;
D2INTRO4 =
Something hisses with rage from the\n
steel tunnels ahead. They know you're\n
here. They have no pity, no mercy, take\n
no quarter, and crave none. They're the\n
perfect enemy, in a way. No one's left\n
but you. You... and Them.;
REDEMTION_INTRO =
The monsters that stood gaurd of the dreaded\n
living end, even those who dwarf you drastically\n
in size, Stood no chance against your killer\n
arsenal and guerrilla warfare tactics.\n
\n
Nerves high and sweat and blood pouring out of\n
you, you march right into the final portal.\n
You know the ones behind it all foresaw your\n
arrival. They know damn well that they can't\n
stall you any longer. All that's left now is\n
to fight head.\n
\n
It's all or nothing now!;
REDEMTION_TXT =
What had once ruled all hellspawn and oversaw\n
the entire earth invasion, are now piles of visceral\n
and metal ash by your boots. The temple of the\n
irredeemable, which took place This gruesome battle,\n
now serves as a reminder to all demon kind that you\n
are not to be messed with.\n
\n
You did it. The invasion has been stopped.\n
Earth is saved. Hell is a wreck. You'll wonder\n
where bad folks will go when they die now.\n
As you make your long trek back home, you\n
contemplate retirement to a lifetime of frivolity\n
after all the rebuilding efforts are done.\n
\n
As the hero to all of this, you deserve it...;
NVINTRO1 =
The Return...\n
\n
Hell's forces have seemingly been\n
vanquished. The military is succesfully\n
fighting back against whatever remnants\n
of the invasion are left.;
NVINTRO2 =
During your vacation, you receive an\n
urgent notice. A portal to a pocket\n
dimension of Hell has opened, and\n
inside, a Cyberdemon is building an army\n
of demons for his own personal use!\n
\n
You must travel there, and end this\n
threat before it is too late.;

column1: You once were the biggest and baddest Cyber-demon to
rule hell and you spear-headed the council that
governed the underworld; "the Cabal". Betrayed by the
other members you find yourself not only dismantled,
but also a victim of the utmost demonic humiliation:
You've been morphed into a human! Of course you're
out for revenge and have to kick the other members of
the Cabal's butts one by one.
Bloodsea Keep is the home of your past advisor;
Veavitdpoh (Very Evil Arch-Vile In The Deepest Parts
Of Hell). Veavitdpoh is an old-school demon that
believes in the rip-out-heart-routine and so shuns
all use of technology and mechanical weaponry. His
cult following has grown the last century but still
amounts to little. Unless you face them alone of
course...
After being dumped into the endless "Sea of Blood"
following your humiliating transformation into a
human you swim for an eternity before you finally
bump your head against the pier of the keep.
Digging your feet into the mud of human remains your
hand brushes by an old blood-soaked shotgun, the
previous owner's severed hand still attached to it.
All who enter "Bloodsea Keep" with such items fall
victim to your former advisor's favourite past-time:
Torture. Any "heretics" still alive inside the keep
should be homicidal maniacs at best.
That's OK you think, "maybe they brought some more
ammo for the shotgun", before cocking the rusty
pump-action, causing an eyeball to fly out of the
cartridge...

Just having escaped the Sea of Blood you have sought
out a derelict building in the search for arms &
equipment. Unfortunately the station isn't as 
abandoned as you thought.

You have come upon one of the Cabal's blood-depoes. 
An important element in any powerful black magic is 
huge amounts of blood. Emptying the depoe's tanks 
into the nearby river you will have struck your first 
blow against the Cabal.
In Mephisto's Maosoleum you have reached the grave of
an old friend and mentor: "Mephisto". Yeah old Lucy
was a tough bastard. But then there was that incident
with the earthling marine which lost him a lot of
credit in the hard-core parts of Hell. So you had to
kick him off the throne of course. His immortal
spirit was kept as a member of the Cabal though and
so he was in on the betrayal against you. Time to
enter his tomb and lay the old man down to rest
for good...

The Cabal has started striking back at you. That 
last gateway should have taken you... well somewhere 
else. Not to an arena where thousands of humans have 
lost their souls to hungry demons. As you get ready
for the first wave of hellspawned gladiators you
swear to blast the emperor's thumbs off before he can
even think about turning them down on you...
When the "Express Elevator to Hell" starts descending
the renegade Cabal has begun to realize you might be
a threat to them, human or not. Half way down the
shaft that should have taken you to the deepest pits
of Hell, the lift first slows down before it jerks to
a halt. Ambush! Survive the initial onslaught and
find a gateway out of the now sealed elevator. Tough,
but that's the way you like it...

You find yourself in the remains of an old forttress                  
after ascending a lift shaft from the mines where you
were trapped. Signs of unlife is evident but from 
what you know of this place it should pose no great 
threat to you. It used to be the centre of a 
Cacodemon empire that perished some 665 yeaes ago. 
Oh, by the way, it's new years eve...
In "Black Tower" you're nearing the end of your
journey. You and Chagrin, the ruler of the Black
Tower, came off the same conveyor belt as newly
assembled cyber-demons a few thousand years back.
Oil runs thicker than blood the two of you used to
say. Demons don't come much closer to friendship than
what you and Chagrin shared. Well now your buddy
rules the hordes of hell previously under your
command and have left you for dead. Your task is
simple: Enter the dreaded Black Tower, the nucleus of
black magic and the occult in all of Hell, get to
its highest floor and slay Chagrin. Then there is the
getting back out as well...

The Image of Evil is a humongous temple created 
to the honour of the first Demon to slay an angel;
Lithlaar. In it you will find the Cybo that now is
known as the lord of Hell and his two Soulguards.

MASTERINT =
Dare Survive...\n
\n
The nightmare continues with the same\n
acid drenched, hell spawned horror of\n
the original invasion. There is life\n
after death, unfortunately.\n
\n
Every step you take may be your last.\n
If it looks too easy, it probably isn't.\n
You might as well forget about seeing\n
the light of day. Ever again.\n
\n
You're doomed.;
TNINTRO1 =
column3: The Story So Far\n

column5: \n
Though all the top management of the UAC\n
were dead, the corporation survived, now\n
under government supervision. The UAC\n
continued its experiments under vastly\n
increased safety measures.\n
\n
The UAC's base was set up on one of the\n
moons of Jupiter, hoping that the\n
increased distance would enhance Earth's\n
safety if something went wrong. Marines\n
were stationed at the base, ready for\n
anything.;

column1: TNINTRO2 =
column3: The Invasion\n

column5: \n
Soon after the UAC opened its first\n
Gate, the minions of Hell made their\n
first attack. However, The United States\n
Space Marine Corps was prepared for such\n
an event, and they poured molten death\n
into the hordes of Hell. Set up in\n
defensive positions around the gate, the\n
marines were able to slaughter the\n
monsters by the hundreds.\n
\n
Hell had failed.;

column1: TNINTRO3 =
column3: The research went on, more boldly, and\n

column5: less cautiously. All the marines\n
received the Silver Star from a grateful\n
government. The defensive positions were\n
strengthened, and the marines watched\n
closely for another attempt, all their\n
attention drawn inward toward the Gates.\n
\n
They were looking in the wrong\n
direction.;

column1: TNINTRO4 = "The Rain of Monsters\n"

column3: "Months after the Gate incident, the\n"
"yearly supply ship came ahead of time.\n"
"The ship was coming from the wrong\n"
"direction. It never landed. Instead, it\n"
"hovered over the base, miles in the air.";

column1: TNINTRO5 =
column2: The ship could not have come from Earth.\n

column3: "It was huge, kilometers long, and was\n"
"built of bone, steel, flesh, corruption,\n"
"and death. Hideous demons poured out,\n"

"pulsing bodies. The marines' defenses,\n"
"set up to prevent an attack from the\n"

column1: TNINTRO6 =
It's Up To You... Again\n
\n
Only one man escaped death or\n
zombification. The marine commander.\n
You. You weren't at the base when the\n
skies opened and devastation poured from\n
the stars.\n
\n
Hot-footing it back to the base, you saw\n
it all and realized what had happened in\n
a flash. The demon ship still floated\n
above the infested base.;
TNINTRO7 =
Unlike the ancient Samurai, who chose to\n
die with their men, you cocked your\n
pistol. You were going to kill for your\n
men. And if you died trying, well, you\n
were going to die anyway, some day.;
PLINTRO1 =
The Story So Far\n
\n
After Hell's invasion of Earth, the\n
United States took steps to prevent it\n
from recurring. The old UAC corporation\n
was refounded, under completely new\n
management, and sent to research how to\n
prevent such an incursion from happening\n
ever again.\n
\n
The new UAC began working on Quantum\n
Accelerator Devices, intended to close\n
interdimensional Gates at a distance.;
PLINTRO2 =
The Terror\n
\n
One day, a Gate opened in the heart of\n
the research complex. The Quantum\n
Accelerator Device performed perfectly\n
in its maiden test -- the invasion Gate\n
was closed instantly and permanently.\n
\n
The next day, a ring of seven Gates\n
opened throughout the base. The Quantum\n
Accelerator began putting out the Gates,\n
and within an hour, six were closed. The\n
marines fought like mad dogs, but were\n
finally pulled down by the enemies'\n
claws.;
E5_INTROTIT3 =
The Task\n
\n
The Quantum Accelerator and its\n
prototypes are deep inside the ravaged\n
complex. The government has ordered all\n
marines to the site at once.\n
\n
You suited up, grabbed a pistol, and\n
raced your pickup truck to the complex.\n
When you arrived, flashes of light,\n
howls, and chanting could be heard from\n
the interior. Corpses were scattered\n
everywhere.;
E5_INTROTXT4 =
You know that within an hour or two, an\n
entire division of marines will arrive\n
to assault the base with full artillery\n
and air support. You also know that they\n
will be too late. They will be plucked\n
from the sky by floating terrors, melted\n
by diabolic fireballs, blasted to\n
shreds. In an hour or two, the\n
monstrosities inside will be prepared,\n
once more, to take on the world.\n
\n
It's up to you. Alone.;
IN_C0P1 =
The Past...\n
\n
Your fatigue was enormous, the price for\n
encountering pure evil. Hell was a place no\n
mortal was meant to experience. Stupid military\n
doctors: their tests and treatments were of\n
little help.\n
In the end, what did it matter - it was all\n
classified and sealed. The nightmares continued.\n
Demons, so many Demons; relentless, pouring through.;
IN_C0P2 =
Far Away...\n
\n
The planetary policy was clear. An absolute\n
quarantine was guaranteed by apocalyptic levels\n
of radiation. The empty dark corridors stand motionless,\n
abandoned. The installations sealed.;
IN_C0P3 =
The Present...\n
\n
A long forgotten relay satellite barely executing,\n
decayed by years of bombarding neutrons, activates\n
and sends its final message to Earth. The satellite's\n
message was horrific, from the planetary void there\n
came energy signatures unlike anything sampled before.;
IN_C0P4 =
The classified archives are opened. The military episodes\n
code named \DOOM\" were not actually completed. A single\n"
entity with vast rejuvenation powers, masked by the extreme\n
radiation levels, escaped detection. In its crippled state,\n
it systematically altered decaying dead carnage back into\n
corrupted living tissue.;
IN_C0P5 =
The mutations are devastating. The Demons have returned\n
even stronger and more vicious than before. As the only\n
experienced survivor of the DOOM episode, your commission\n
is re-activated. Your assignment is clear:\n
\n
MERCILESS EXTERMINATION!;

teleport haze.\n
\n
Another UAC base tainted by the unending\n
hellspawn.  Its vast silence reminds you\n
of the military morgue.\n
\n
Once again you find yourself amidst...;

You realize the demons mock you with\n

\n

IN_TR1 =

column3: "With the death of the Demon-Spitter, the army of the damned\n"
"loses their gateway to our world, and they slowly evaporate\n"
"around you, writhing with screams of agony.\n"
"Then, everything is silent, and the hellish red sky and\n"
"the stench of sulfur fade away almost as if nothing had ever happened at all.\n";

column1: IN_TR2 =

column3: "Have you won? Is this another victory for mankind?\n"
"No, something isn't right, there's a blue glow coming from the\n"
"inside of the Demon-Spitter's head.\n"
"You crawl into the now exposed brain and find a\n"
"mix of technology and organic material fused so\n"
"that you can't tell where one stops and the other begins.\n"
"The glow is coming from a nearby computer panel.\n"
"A look of horror spreads across your face as you realize what has happened:\n"
"by killing the Demon-Spitter, you have activated some sort of locating device.\n"
"Now an even bigger fleet of ships full of demons is on its way to Io.\n";

column1: IN_TR3 =

column3: "The yearly supply ship from Mars is still weeks away from your position.\n"
"Looks like you're the only one standing between the demons and Earth\n"
"There's no way for you to make a stand at the now completely destroyed\n"
"UAC base,so you head for a nearby thermal power station that\n"
"taps into one of Io's many active volcanoes.\n"
"Since it's several miles' walk, you need to travel light.\n"
"Looks like you'll only be taking your pistol for protection,\n"
"but hopefully you'll resupply on weapons before the demons arrive.\n";

column1: IN_TR4 =

column3: "Hours later, you find yourself at the walls of the power station.\n"
"Suddenly you hear rumbling from above,and a great explosion fills\n"
"the sky as the moon Ganymede explodes into several pieces.\n"
"Once the dust clears, you see a great skull where the moon used to be.\n"
"A fleet of hell ships materialize from the skull.\n"
"Most of the ships head on a course for Earth,\n"
"but one heads directly for your position.\n"
"So much for finding weapons before they arrive.\n"
"It's up to you to make it to the Communications Center before\n"
"the demons destroy the satellite array so that you can send a\n"
"message to Earth warning humanity of its impending Doom.\n"
"Good luck, marine.\n";

column1: IN_PT1 =
"After the failure of the Quantum Accelerator technology that brought\n"
"the Earth to a second onslaught from Hell's denizens, interplanetary court\n"
"cases showed the UAC's lack of ethics managing Gateway technology, so the\n"
"corporation was divested of asse,ts and many of its surviving officials\n"
"were sentenced to years of prison.\n"
"The corporation's substantial assets\n"
"were assigned to the newly formed Union Aerospace Armed Forces,\n"
"a multi-planetary security force in charge of\n"
"keeping Hell from ever reaching our dimension again.\n";
IN_PT2 =
"To pursue its commitment, the UAAF developed a series of Hallion\n"
"Colliders, devices that would supplant the ineffective Quantum\n"
"Accelerators, ensuring that all interstellar teleportation would from\n"
"then on remain isolated from any Gates of Hell. This project came under\n"
"close scrutiny of the press, which dubbed it \"Plutonia 2\" in reference\n"
"to the previous experiment.\n";
IN_PT3 =
"For some time, things seemed well, but eventually the UAAF, by far the\n"
"greatest military force known to man, came under conflict with various\n"
"colonies which accused the institution of overstepping its bounds and\n"
"misusing its authority.\n"
"This led to the recent state of interstellar\n"
"guerrilla warfare and political plotting that has destabilized the UAAF,\n"
"splitting it into various factions jockeying for power.\n";
IN_PT4 =
"Your Situation...\n"
"After your successful mission to destroy the Quantum Accelerators and\n"
"once again baffle the forces of Hell, you were accepted as one of the\n"
"architects of the UAAF, but were eventually forced to renounce your chair\n"
"in its committee after the use of excessive force was alleged in a dispute\n"
"within an ex-UAC colony you were supervising. It wasn't really your thing,\n"
"anyway. Too much paperwork.\n";
IN_PT5 =
"The worsening situation, however, did concern\n"
"you, and you used your newly gained freedom from responsibility to play a\n"
"role in solving some of the disputes the increasing rivalries produced.\n"
"When things went out of control you proposed a plan, Operation Kick-ass,\n"
"to correct the situation, but it was blocked when your public image was\n"
"damaged by opponents, particularly with the much publicized study stating\n"
"that repeated use of the UAC Berserk, Medikit and Stimpack brands of\n"
"medical supplies could cause psychosis and paranoia in users who had\n"
"already been through severe trauma. This has left you ostracized from\n"
"the political arena, unable to intervene in a diplomatic way.\n";
IN_PT6 =
"EVIL UNLEASHED!\n"
"With you out of the picture, the political climate became even more\n"
"turbulent. One day, news arrived that Hell's minions were back, invading\n"
"parts of the Earth! Allegations and accusations flew to and fro as groups\n"
"and factions blamed sabotage, espionage or the UAAF itself for unleashing\n"
"the terrors once more. The guerrilla warfare became all-out war of all\n"
"sorts; human against human, human against hellish monster, and even\n"
"monster against monster.\n";
IN_PT7 =
"As everyone knows by now, you aren't one to sit by as all Hell breaks\n"
"loose. The world has forgotten you, but you know you'll regret what will\n"
"happen if you don't act now. You holster your trusty pistol, the only\n"
"weapon you've been allowed to keep, and head off to the teleporter that\n"
"will lead you to the Amazonian jungle, where you judge it will be easiest\n"
"to infiltrate enemy lines.\n";
IN_PG1 =
"Four years have passed since Earth marine forces won the war against\n"

column3: the Hellian aggressors. You are a cadet marine who has been called upon to serve\n
in the UAC strike force while they continue running controlled gateway\n
experiments at their Earth headquarters.\n
Arriving at the main gate on your first day of service, you notice that\n
things don't seem to be running normally at the UAC headquarters.\n
\n
You pull out your service handgun, and enter the main gate suspecting the worst.\n
\n
Little do you know, but you are about to embark on a journey to the\n
overseers' world, the dawn of a new battle on another plane of existence.\n
\n
Hopefully, you have what it takes to clean out the alien world,\n
and find the portal leading to the plane of hell itself, hopefully,\n
you can find and destroy PERDITIONS GATE.\n;

column1: IN_LE1 =

column3: "You're the lone occupant aboard a\n"
"utilitarian deep space probe returning to Earth.\n"
"Your six-month reconnaissance mission of the outer\n"
"Solar System is over and you're finally headed back home.";

column1: IN_LE2 =

column3: "Lying motionless, seemingly lifeless,\n"
"in the cryogenic glass and metal chamber,\n"
"you resemble a techno-mummy in display.\n"
"Only the readouts and blinking panel lights\n"
"reveal there is indeed a heartbeat, though its rate\n"
"crawls at a tenth of its normal resting state.\n"
"When you put your head down in the comfy cushion of the\n"
"cryogenic chamber and took a deep, prolonged breath,\n"
"you knew two months would pass before you would\n"
"open your eyes again, at which time you would be approaching\n"
"the lunar space station.\n";

column1: IN_LE3 =

column3: "\"Then I'm headed for the mountains,\"\n"
"you told yourself, giving in to the\n"
"overwhelming feeling of elation induced by the chambers' gases.\n"
"But fate had other plans for you.\n";

column1: IN_LE4 =

column3: "As your probe enters the large nether region between Mars and Jupiter,\n"
"coming within a few thousand miles from the asteroid belt,\n"
"the navigation system eases the ship into a complete stop.\n"
"A chain reaction of commands and\n"
"subroutines restores breathable air in the cabin.\n"
"Meanwhile, the chemicals in the chamber self-adjust\n"
"to normalize your metabolism.\n"
"As consciousness returns and the\n"
"clouds of deep sleep begin to dissipate, You see\n"
"yourself headed for the mountains. But you're still dreaming.\n";

column1: IN_LE5 =

column3: "Any premature feeling of euphoria is swiftly squelched\n"
"as the seal of the cryo-chamber breaks open.\n"
"The high-pitched shrill you hear is an\n"
"unmistakable distress code signal.\n"
"With a last click on the keyboard, the course for Io is set.\n"
"You don't know what evil awaits you, but you're sure\n"
"the mountains of Earth will have to wait just a little bit longer.\n";

column1: KAINTRO1 =

\n
You're a veteran Quality Control Manager at\n
a Kick bottling plant. Your world is one of\n
suits and ties, tests and reports, but above\n
all making sure that every bottle of Kick that\n
hits the streets is a brain-mashing brew of\n
nitro-driven fizz.;

\n
The line has been shut down and you pulled\n
the cord. You didn't need a spectrometer to\n
know that something was wrong - this batch\n
was weak, it did nothing for mouth or mind.\n

\n
So you, with loosened tie and your jacket\n
on a hook were crawling through passageways\n
trying to find the problem. Storage tanks,\n
feeder pipes, filling nozzles, just what you\n
expected. . .but wait.  What's that?  Out of a\n
newly cut scar on the side of an otherwise\n
pristine wall came a crudely fashioned pipe.\n
Clumsily welded to a major feeder main,\n
it disappeared into the darkness.;

screwdriver, the liquid that dripped to the\n

to take the kick out of Kick!  You could already\n

of flying two liter bottles with teeth so sharp\n

\n
Something had to be done and you were the man\n
to do it.  Tie off, armed only with the pistol\n
from your desk and a can of Kick you crawled into\n

\n
It was time to Kick some Alpine ass. . .;
